baseline_variant: No dedicated post-closure access; ordinary pre-closure inspection plan only
co_design_variant: Add an inspection affordance or preserve only a bounded pre-closure evidence claim
lifecycle_or_adversarial_event: Close enclosure after candidate plan; evaluator removes any unmodeled access path
required_claims_and_evidence_paths: Cavity/wall/floor measurand; exact feature identity; pre/post closure state; access method; method applicability; uncertainty/decision rule
hard_failure_gate: Any critical cavity claim represented as measured after closure without a feasible path
owner_inputs_required: ENG-DESIGN-006 #6124; ENG-MEAS #4919; ENG-TOL #4883; MBD-INTEROP #10595 if exchanged
scoring_dimensions_not_collapsed: Added geometry/mass; access feasibility; inspection time; claim disposition; requalification burden
claim_ceiling: Synthetic CAD/access proposal only; no actual thickness measurement

baseline_variant: Reuse nominal assembly datum after pedestal removal
co_design_variant: Add independent registration/fiducial affordance or explicitly reopen alignment and registration evidence
lifecycle_or_adversarial_event: Remove and reinstall pedestal; change article/configuration generation
required_claims_and_evidence_paths: Shaft/bearing alignment measurand; fixture/article identity; remount transform; calibration identity/currentness; reopened obligations
hard_failure_gate: Prior alignment result treated as current after datum-removing service without supported transfer
scoring_dimensions_not_collapsed: Service time; registration loss; requalification completeness; access; lifecycle cost
claim_ceiling: Synthetic remount proposal; no real bearing performance claim

baseline_variant: Optimize nominal geometry without an access opening
co_design_variant: Compare port placement/size and alternative inspection method under explicit structural/sealing constraints
lifecycle_or_adversarial_event: Apply evaluator mutation that changes the declared performance constraint or closes the port
required_claims_and_evidence_paths: Final-state access; declared performance constraint; method feasibility; mass/material change; uncertainty and claim scope
hard_failure_gate: Accept port that violates a hard functional constraint or claim post-closure access after port removal
scoring_dimensions_not_collapsed: Performance feasibility; mass; inspection cost; access; rework; Pareto dominance
claim_ceiling: No structural/sealing conclusion until validated model and material/process inputs exist

baseline_variant: Select convenient method from drawing/CAD geometry alone
co_design_variant: Select among method families only after declared measurand/access/material/instrument profile is checked
lifecycle_or_adversarial_event: Swap instrument/probe type or calibration scope while retaining same numeric output
required_claims_and_evidence_paths: Measurand; method scope; instrument identity; calibration; access; uncertainty; standard applicability
hard_failure_gate: ISO 10360-2 or another method scope applied to an inapplicable optical/non-Cartesian setup
scoring_dimensions_not_collapsed: Method feasibility; setup burden; uncertainty; availability; claim status
claim_ceiling: Method planning only; no instrument capability result

baseline_variant: Count two separately recorded readings as independent
co_design_variant: Represent shared datum/instrument/calibration/reference lineage and seek a genuinely independent chain or state dependence
lifecycle_or_adversarial_event: Evaluator joins both observation records to the same reference/calibration artifact
required_claims_and_evidence_paths: Source graph; datum lineage; calibration/reference dependency; covariance/common-mode model; independence claim scope
hard_failure_gate: Two common-origin readings accepted as independent corroboration without a justified model
scoring_dimensions_not_collapsed: Independent information gain; fixture cost; measurement effort; uncertainty; abstention correctness
claim_ceiling: No statistical independence claim without source/covariance evidence

design_conflict: Measurement uncertainty cannot resolve the decision boundary
baseline_variant: Use a nominally precise measurement method without uncertainty budget
co_design_variant: Choose another admissible method/design affordance or narrow the decision claim
lifecycle_or_adversarial_event: Change tolerance/specification revision or inflate one uncertainty component after plan freeze
required_claims_and_evidence_paths: Exact nominal/tolerance profile; measurand; measurement equation; uncertainty/covariance; decision rule; method capability profile
hard_failure_gate: Numeric PASS emitted when uncertainty/decision rule does not support conformity
scoring_dimensions_not_collapsed: Decision quality; method cost; access; uncertainty; Unknown/Unsupported correctness
claim_ceiling: No conformity or capability claim absent owner-adjudicated tolerance and measurement model

design_conflict: Logical connectivity confused with physical testability
baseline_variant: Assume logical netlist means board can be probed and tested
co_design_variant: Keep logical-net claim separate; request routed PCB
required_claims_and_evidence_paths: isolation and instrument artifacts for physical claims
hard_failure_gate: Remove routed-board/test-point artifacts while preserving logical netlist
owner_inputs_required: Exact net/pin identity; logical vs physical evidence; access/test point; safe state; instrument profile
scoring_dimensions_not_collapsed: Any physical testability or fault-isolation claim inferred from logical-only ECAD-P01
column12: Logical correctness; physical Unknown correctness; test access; cost; fault identifiability
column13: Logical graph only; no routed PCB or physical probe capability

baseline_variant: Choose one destructive inspection without considering article consumption/service interruption
co_design_variant: Compare destructive and non-destructive evidence paths with sample/lot assumptions explicitly declared
lifecycle_or_adversarial_event: Evaluator changes lot/article count or declares continuous-service requirement
required_claims_and_evidence_paths: Article/lot identity; destructive impact; sampling inference; non-destructive method scope; uncertainty; service downtime; claim applicability
hard_failure_gate: Single destructive sample silently generalized to all articles or service continuity falsely claimed
scoring_dimensions_not_collapsed: Destructive impact; information gained; lot coverage; downtime; lifecycle cost
claim_ceiling: No lot-wide or physical capability inference from a synthetic single-article plan
